## PreflightCheckError.knownBackendTypes property

The backend type identifiers that were registered when validation ran — the valid options — present only for a `'config-unknown-backend'` failure. Lets a consumer offer the same "Available types: …" guidance the runtime `BackendUnavailableError` gives.

**Signature:**

```typescript
knownBackendTypes?: readonly string[] | undefined;
```
